doc: Masks the low byte of a0 (an event/message code), reports it via func_800558FC, then for a small whitelist of codes (0x11,0x12,0x14,0x18) translates it to a sequential index (0,1,2,3) and forwards that to func_80055BD8; other codes are ignored.
calls: func_800558FC(s32 a0) -- extern void, called with (a0 & 0xFF)
func_80055BD8(s32 a0) -- extern void, called with translated event code
